newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai ban on use of CFCs effective on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Thai ban on use of CFCs effective on Tuesday.

text.p: Thailand's decision to phase out environmentally-harmful chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) will take effect from Tuesday, Deputy Finance Minister Thawatwong Na Chiang Mai said on Monday.

CFCs, widely used as coolants in refrigerators and air conditioners, are blamed for damaging the earth's protective ozone layer. A global reduction in use of CFCs was agreed in the 1987 Montreal Protocol.

The Thai government has spent 175 million baht (US$7 million) on incentives to help the eight domestic refrigerator manufacturers and two compressor-makers to end their production of CFC-based refrigerators.
